\caption{Proof size, verifier time, and prover memory for pairing-based and transparent proof systems. zkML (Halo2 with KZG or IPA): \gls{mnist} (MNST), \gls{resnet18} (R18), \gls{dlrm} (DLRM), \gls{mobilenet} (Mob), \gls{vgg} (VGG), \gls{diffusion} (Diff), and \gls{gpt2} (GPT). TLSNotary (Noir on Barretenberg UltraHonk with KZG, or ProveKit with WHIR): the use cases of \Cref{tab:eval:prover}; Artemis on Barretenberg and Lego are cost estimates, and the Barretenberg verifier time is the wall-clock of \texttt{bb verify} minus that on an empty circuit. Lego: LegoSNARK. Missing entries (-): Lunar and LegoSNARK require a pairing-based proof system and Lunar is not implemented for UltraHonk; Poseidon fails to scale to GPT-2; SHA-256 and the remaining TLSNotary entries were not run or ran out of memory, as described in~\Cref{sec:eval:results} and \Cref{tab:eval:prover}.}
